performance.method: Fresh sequential processes FP32, repaired Q4F16, repaired Q4F16, FP32. Includes tokenization, tensor creation, inference, full output transfer and host CLS+L2. Original official FP32 ONNX baseline. Synthetic fixed-length hello workload; same 3 warmups and 60/60/40/20/20/10 repeats as CPU report. Shared desktop. RSS is process RSS, not total GPU memory.

sustained.method: Q4F16 then FP32; batch 1/8/32, 512 tokens. Pretokenized, tensors created per run, full output and host CLS/L2; 2 warmups then >=10 sec each. No utilization/power/temperature claims.
